en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2769 - Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id narrated from Hammad, from Muhammad ibn Maymun, who said:
Imam Abu al-Hasan (as) arrived performing tamattu‘ on the night of Arafah. He performed tawaf, exited ihram, approached one of his servant women, then entered ihram for Hajj and proceeded [to Mina].
